grades.quote: When there are no more bytes to read, read returns zero to indicate the end of the file.
grades.reason: Defines EOF for read (returns zero when no more bytes) and says file descriptors cover pipes. It never says that pipe EOF needs every write-end descriptor to be closed, including the parent's copy. It gives only background for the diagnosis.
Covers the bounded-buffer producer/consumer pattern and mentions Unix pipes in general. It says nothing about EOF, closing write ends, or why a pipe reader never sees EOF after a child exits.
